certificates.reason: Reviewed the approved swarm definition and session-operation correction against all 16 atomic delivery conditions and seven requirement owners. Every explicit resource/association operation and skill responsibility has an identified acceptance Arc; Codex session control is excluded by stakeholder authority. No missing approved responsibility was found.

Reviewed typed owner/inventory/help/command proofs and real PostgreSQL/Git lifecycle workflows for the seven requirement groups. Existing tests are the verification owners for the 16 registered delivery responsibilities; no additional independent unit-proof responsibility is required. This assesses completeness of the proof inventory, not final full-suite execution.

OBL-1: Owner resolution is proved by owner/managed equivalence, sibling isolation and explicit ambiguous/cross-repository refusal, including current read-only GWEN inspection. OBL-19: Reviewed all16 approved delivery responsibilities against their real typed implementations and verification owners; the completion audit and independent review identify no missing approved functionality. Native session API controls are excluded by stakeholder authority.

OBL-2: Concurrent coordinator bindings have one winner; stale unbind is rejected and worker/checkouts survive explicit coordinator loss. OBL-10: Real CLI allocation/setup and competing-owner Arcs prove lowest eligible numbers above100, correct base, retained setup intent and same-checkout recovery.

OBL-3: Real owner/managed CLI inventory reports exact associations, empty inventories and sibling isolation without mutations. OBL-5: Concurrent worker admission has one winner and records immutable original owner/checkout/session; cross-owner and cross-checkout rebinding fail.

OBL-4: V4 reports runtime unobserved and missing resources explicitly. The CLI fixture proves its failing Codex executable is never invoked. OBL-6: Host-quiesced CLI detachment fences only the matching campaign lease/actions, preserves evidence/source and removes only its matching marker; retries are stable. OBL-8: Worker tests establish incremental W numbers, shared P/S full-assignment mapping and three-word desired names; the skill directs coordinator host naming.

OBL-7: Original remove/rebind retains session and checkout identity; session provenance survives clearing and prevents cross-owner reuse. Host resumption remains separate. OBL-9: Completion records and reports the DONE-prefixed desired name without changing acceptance or ownership; the skill assigns actual naming to coordinator host tools. OBL-11: Release/transfer Arcs preserve source/checkout and exclusive ownership; retained actors, markers, active Git operations and dirty source prevent unsafe reuse.

OBL-12: Selected deletion Arc protects assigned/user resources, preserves committed source refs and retries durable cleanup refusal. OBL-14: Installed CLI/PG clear releases owner associations/leases/actions while preserving origins/checkouts/evidence and isolating sibling owners; cleanup refusal retains ownership.
OBL-13: All-unassigned deletion Arc reports protected/retained/deleted resources and retries outstanding cleanup only.
OBL-15: Scoped chapter/subcommand help and actual swarm CLI/PG Arcs cover the required resource operations. Campaign CLI/MCP retire session endpoints without aliases.

OBL-16: Registered skill and actual isolated installer agree with shipped commands. Independent scenario review accepts N10 compatible parallelism, original-worker priority, host session operations and truthful identity/root capability limits.

All16 approved delivery responsibilities have identified actual CLI/PostgreSQL/Git integration Arcs or skill installation/scenario proof. Owner routing, original-session association, setup/reuse/release/deletion/clear, campaign adoption and retired session endpoints have real verification owners; no missing required workflow is inferred from superseded native-control criteria.

The configured complete npm test command finished successfully after final source edits:559 legacy Node tests,325 typed tests,23 Pi tests,4 MCP tests and100 TSTS tests, plus installer, generator, traceability and static checks. Relevant tracked source inputs are unchanged; the retained unrelated bug-document edit is outside this proof scope.

The same successful final npm test command includes all configured integration workflows (there is no separate integration suite): actual CLI/MCP/Git/PostgreSQL fixtures prove the approved swarm lifecycle, retained-worker scope renewal and campaign association boundaries. No skip or failed Arc is accepted as passing proof.
